wars.name: Seljuk succession of 1159-1160 (Arslan-Shah and Muhammad ibn Mas'ud's son)
wars.outcome: 'His son Aq-Sonqur II was Ataberg for the infant son of Muhammad ibn Mas'ud in 1159 and in 1160 tried to impose him in place of Arslan-Shah (Seljuk sultan), who was supported by the Eldiguzids for the Seljuk succession, but in vain' (Ahmadilis page).

wars.name: Mongol sack of Maragheh
wars.outcome: 'The Mongols stormed the city on 30 March 1221 and burned it and killed its inhabitants'; the generals Jebe and Subutai led the conquest; Sulafa Khatun 'was at Ru'in Dez' (Maragheh page).

certainty.note: Only Maragheh (and the fortress of Ru'in Dez) is named; the 50 km disc is an approximation.
